seen: No measurement of this game exists; none was taken, and I saw no score of it or of its parent.
claim: Black wins by force in 8 of its own moves, and no win for either side can come sooner.
change: setup: White has pawns on b3 and e2, Black a king on f8; castling removed (no rook stands).

proof.text: Black wins by taking White's last piece (`rules.extinction`). The certificate opens with every White first move and gives Black's move at each of its turns and every White reply, to positions the engine calls won for Black, within 8 Black moves; `labelled/verify.py` walks it. A `shortest` check finds no forced Black win in 7, and White cannot win first along any line of the certificate. A White win is reachable (the `line` check: both pawns promote and mate the bare king), so there is no plain defect.

review.given: the spec file, describe_rules' text, the claim and the proof (with its certificate or checks); told not to read docs/, runs/, other labels, the build log or any score, and to run no player
review.notes: An independent ply-counting search: Black's earliest forced win is ply 16 (its 8th move), no White forced win within 9 plies; a White win is reachable (two promotions and mate).
